entries.en: Sakamoto-kun was late again.[n]Maybe he'll get expelled soon?

entries.speaker: Carefree Female Student
entries.en: I can't believe he's still behaving like this[n]after what he did to the track team.
entries.uk: Не віриться, що він досі так поводиться[n]після того, що зробив із легкоатлетами.

entries.speaker: Carefree Female Student
entries.en: And he's still not expelled because[n]Mr. Kamoshida's covering for him,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Timid Female Student
entries.en: Mr. Kamoshida's too nice for not[n]abandoning a punk like that...

entries.speaker: Female Volleyball Player
entries.en: Did you know, Senpai? Some crazy[n]second-year student is transferring[n]to our school.

entries.speaker: Male Volleyball Player
entries.en: Yeah, I heard about him. All the second-[n]years are talking about it.
entries.uk: Ага, чув про нього. Усі другокласники[n]тільки про це й говорять.

entries.speaker: Male Volleyball Player
entries.en: Apparently, he's such a problem student[n]that no other schools will take him.

entries.speaker: Female Volleyball Player
entries.en: Why does he have to come here...?[n]I hope he doesn't try anything[n]funny with the volleyball team.

entries.speaker: Male Volleyball Player
entries.en: It's fine. Mr. Kamoshida's on our side.[n]The transfer student won't do anything[n]to us.
